basic_profile.bio: I'm a 28-year-old audio enthusiast living in Denver, Colorado. I've been running my own podcast for over five years, where I handle everything from editing to marketing. I'm passionate about audio storytelling and hope to find a career in the same field. I enjoy watching Denver Broncos games and have a soft spot for comedy shows like Reno 911. In my spare time, I mod games like Witcher 3. I'm currently single and typically online in the evenings after work.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a degree in Communications with a focus on Media Production. Most of my skills, such as audio editing and digital marketing, are self-taught through online courses and practical experience managing my podcast.
